text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Satsuki Sho, Biwa<n>Hayahide is
excited to compete with<n>fierce racers like Winning
Ticket and<n>Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Narita Taishin wrestles<n>with the
annoyance of constantly<n>being dismissed due to
her small<n>stature.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Biwa Hayahide<n>notices that Narita
Taishin seems off<n>and tries to reach out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, the look in Narita Taishin's<n>eyes
indicates that she is in no mood<n>to talk. She leaves
without saying a<n>word.
